figurative_meaning_en: Belonging to the same group; people sharing the same qualities; of the same lineage
example_sentences_in_bangla: তারা এককলসীর জল, সবাই একই ধরনের কাজ করে।
এই দুই বন্ধু এককলসীর জল, কখনো বিচ্যুতি হয় না।
example_sentences_in_english: They are water from the same pitcher, all doing the same kind of work.
These two friends are water from the same pitcher, never parting ways.
note: This idiom draws from traditional rural imagery of shared resources in Bengali households.
